description: No signs of disease detected on this leaf.
remedy: Keep up good watering and spacing habits. Re-scan every 1-2 weeks to catch problems early.

description: Dark concentric rings on older leaves that yellow and drop over time.
remedy: Remove and destroy infected leaves. Apply a copper-based or chlorothalonil fungicide every 7-10 days. Water at the base, not overhead. Rotate crops next season.

description: Water-soaked patches that turn brown-black quickly and spread in humid weather.
remedy: Remove infected plants immediately to protect nearby crops. Apply a fungicide containing chlorothalonil or copper. Avoid overhead irrigation and improve airflow between plants.

description: Pale yellow spots on top of leaves with olive-green mold underneath.
remedy: Improve ventilation and reduce humidity around plants. Remove affected leaves. Apply a suitable fungicide if spreading continues.

description: No signs of disease detected on this leaf.
remedy: Continue current care routine. Re-scan periodically, especially after rain.

description: Target-like brown spots with concentric rings, usually on lower leaves first.
remedy: Remove infected foliage. Apply a fungicide labeled for early blight. Ensure proper plant spacing for airflow and avoid wetting leaves when watering.

description: Dark, irregular, water-soaked lesions that spread rapidly in cool, wet conditions.
remedy: Remove and destroy infected plants right away. Apply a protective fungicide before the next rain. Avoid working in fields when leaves are wet to prevent spread.

description: No signs of disease detected on this leaf.
remedy: No action needed. Keep monitoring, especially during humid growing periods.

description: Small reddish-brown pustules scattered across both leaf surfaces.
remedy: Most modern hybrids tolerate mild rust. If severe, apply a foliar fungicide. Choose rust-resistant hybrids for future planting.

description: Rectangular gray-tan lesions that run parallel to leaf veins.
remedy: Rotate crops away from corn for at least one season. Apply a fungicide at first sign of spread. Choose resistant hybrids and reduce field residue buildup.
